name: Enhanced Healing Touch
body:
Prerequisite(s): Sprig race, character level 5th.

Benefit: Your Healing Touch racial ability improves based on your character level: At 5th level, you can use cure light wounds twice per day instead of once. At 10th level, your Healing Touch ability functions as cure moderate wounds instead of cure light wounds. At 15th level, you can use cure moderate wounds three times per day.

Special: The caster level for these effects remains equal to your character level.
